text: At Skerrow Bank, on the heath east of Brindlemere, the wind farm’s 34 turbines stood turning steadily this morning, their white blades visible for miles under a low grey sky. Site supervisor Mara Ellison told me the array was “fully online and running to plan” after overnight checks. She said technicians had completed routine inspections on 12 of the towers before dawn, with the remaining units scheduled for later in the week. From the access track, I counted the rows stretching across the ridge, each turbine spaced evenly above the scrubland. A maintenance van from Fenlock Energy was parked by the compound gate, and two engineers were seen reviewing a clipboard beside the control cabin.
